CustomField.formula: IF ( !ISBLANK(DMT_Product_family__c) && ISBLANK(DMT_Product_Subfamily__c) && ISBLANK(DMT_Product_category__c) && ISBLANK(DMT_Global_Product_Id__c) && ISBLANK(DMT_Product_Subcategory__c),"Family", IF(!ISBLANK(DMT_Product_Subfamily__c) && ISBLANK(DMT_Product_category__c) && ISBLANK(DMT_Global_Product_Id__c) && ISBLANK(DMT_Product_Subcategory__c),"Subfamily", IF(!ISBLANK(DMT_Product_category__c) && ISBLANK(DMT_Global_Product_Id__c) && ISBLANK(DMT_Product_Subcategory__c),"Category", IF(ISBLANK(DMT_Global_Product_Id__c) && !ISBLANK(DMT_Product_Subcategory__c),"Subcategory", IF(!ISBLANK(DMT_Global_Product_Id__c),"Global Product","NO LEVEL")))))
CustomField.label: Classification Level
